preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 500000
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 500 000) representing the number of hashtags.

preconditions.expression: all('#' == hashtag[0] and len(hashtag) > 1 for hashtag in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the next n lines is a valid hashtag: a string starting with '#' followed by at least one lowercase English letter.
The total length of all hashtags (excluding '#') does not exceed 500 000.

postconditions.expression: all('#' == output_hashtag[0] for output_hashtag in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Every output line is a valid hashtag (starts with '#').
Each output hashtag has at least the '#' symbol (length ≥ 1).

postconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for hashtag in stdout.splitlines() for c in hashtag[1:])
postconditions.description: All characters after '#' in each output hashtag are lowercase English letters.
The output contains exactly n lines, one for each input hashtag.

postconditions.expression: all(lex_compare(output_hashtags[i], output_hashtags[i+1]) <= 0 for i in range(len(output_hashtags) - 1))
postconditions.description: The output hashtags are in lexicographical order, where lex_compare(a, b) returns -1 if a < b, 0 if a == b, and 1 if a > b (using the problem's definition).

postconditions.expression: sum(len(output_hashtag) - 1 for output_hashtag in stdout.splitlines()) == min_possible_deletions
postconditions.description: The total number of deleted characters (excluding '#') is minimized, where min_possible_deletions is the smallest possible sum of deletions across all valid solutions.
